name: Dobugawa Kochou
source:
A girl who wants to be student body president. She is relentless in her attempts to overpower others.

She frequently uses four-letter idioms, but their meanings are unclear.

She gets grumpy when you call her by her first name.

She has no friends at all. She has no experience in masturbation.
